correctness.rationale: For the repaired direction, cancellation of mask weights and source-law averaging give Eq. (1); conditional entropy with two boundaries is a_k+a_l-a_(k+l), and the finite-end correction per site vanishes, including zero previous density. Geometric scaling, exponentially bounded rescaled tails and Gamma(1,1)/Gamma(2,1) log moments give F_r(u) ~ r/(2u) when r/u tends to zero and u tends to zero. Strict subadditivity gives a positive limit for nonzero bounded r/u, while r/u tending to infinity gives log 2. A cost O(r^(2/3)) forces p=O(r^(2/3)); it first forces q to zero, then q bounded below on the r^(1/3) scale by the final-round term, and then forces p and q into compact rescaled ranges by the second term. The three rescaled leading terms have constant product log(2)/4, and equalizing them gives exactly the stated constants for every global minimizer. Inspected the frozen checker’s finite likelihood direction and tests, without executing it; the limiting proof is analytic.
